prompts.decode_mystery: One night, Tom heard a strange noise in the garden. He took a flashlight and went outside to see what it was.
prompts.decode_discovery: Lily was digging in the sand at the beach when she found a shiny box with a tiny key on top.
prompts.decode_unusual_character: There was once a little dragon who was afraid of fire. Every day he hid behind a big rock.
prompts.decode_problem: Ben's kite was stuck high up in a tall tree and he could not reach it. He looked around for help.
prompts.decode_unexpected_ending: Mia and her dog went for a walk in the park. Everything was quiet and sunny until the dog stopped and started to bark.
prompts.twist_exam_paper: A girl named Sara found her test paper on the desk. When she opened it, she saw that it already had the answers to the questions for tomorrow.
prompts.twist_future_robot: An old robot sat alone in the garage. One day, a little light on his chest began to blink and he got a message from himself in the future.
prompts.twist_detective: The detective walked into the empty house. Every clock on the wall had stopped at midnight. Suddenly, the phone began to ring.
prompts.twist_forgotten_day: One morning, everyone in the village woke up and nobody could remember what happened the day before.
prompts.twist_future_letter: Jack found a letter in his mailbox with his name on it. The letter was written one hundred years in the future.
